notes: Strict matching per prompt_align.md. Kela caseworker and Kela system treated as the same actor; actor differences recorded in match_type_note. Generated evidence text ignored. order_checks: (predecessor, step) pairs from the reference predecessor lists, in reference order, where both steps are matched (pairs whose matches collapse to the same single node are skipped), capped at 60. For each pair the shortest path over all matched-node combinations (excluding identical nodes) is computed in both directions; same_order is true only if a forward path exists and is no longer than the reverse path, false if the reverse path is shorter or only the reverse exists, 'not_connected' if neither exists.
